+++ b/src/_pytest/lenient_char_width.py
@@ -0,0 +1,9 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from _pytest._io.wcwidth import wcwidth
+
+
+def lenient_char_width(c: str) -> int:
+    """Return the terminal width of a character, treating controls as zero-width."""
+    width = wcwidth(c)
+    return 0 if width == -1 else width

 )
 def test_wcwidth(c: str, expected: int) -> None:
     assert wcwidth(c) == expected
+    assert lenient_char_width(c) == max(0, expected)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("c", ["\x1f", "\x7f", "\x80", "\x9f"])
+def test_lenient_char_width_controls(c: str) -> None:
+    assert lenient_char_width(c) == 0
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("c", ["", "ab"])
+def test_lenient_char_width_invalid_length(c: str) -> None:
+    with pytest.raises(TypeError) as expected:
+        wcwidth(c)
+    with pytest.raises(TypeError) as actual:
+        lenient_char_width(c)
+    assert actual.value.args == expected.value.args

notes:
